van_de: YOLO26 (COCO) khong co lop three_wheeler: tuk-tuk bi goi la car/truck. Pilot: 4 tuk-tuk -> car+truck; YOLOE voi prompt three_wheeler tim dung 4 box cung vi tri.
quyet_dinh: Moi xe 3 banh co mui (tuk-tuk, xich lo, xe ba gac) LUON gan three_wheeler; khong dung car/truck cho xe 3 banh.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.2: three_wheeler = tuk-tuk + xich lo/cyclo + xe ba gac; car/truck KHONG bao gom xe 3 banh.

van_de: YOLOE conf 0.05 gan three_wheeler len ro hang, mai hien, bien hieu va ca xe buyt (img_018 box 549,318 -> bus). 21/43 box three_wheeler trong lo bi xoa khi duyet.
quyet_dinh: Chi giu three_wheeler khi thay ro than xe + 3 banh. Box nam tren ro hang / bien hieu / mai hien phai xoa, khong doi lop.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.1.6: truoc khi Accepted mot box three_wheeler cua model, kiem bang mat: co than xe va 3 banh khong.

van_de: Cau 3 muc 6: hang nho ra (ro trai cay tren xe dap, xe ba gac cho rau). Box/mask co gom hang khong?
quyet_dinh: Box va mask chi om than xe. Hang nho ra qua ~20% chieu dai xe khong tinh vao box/mask; nguoi danh gia tu cat mask SAM.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.2 (mo rong): hang hoa nho ra >20% chieu dai than xe khong thuoc box/mask cua xe.

van_de: Cau 2 muc 6: khoi xe may do day dac GAN camera (khong phai o xa): ve tung xe hay ignore_region?
quyet_dinh: >=5 vat sat nhau va cao <20px thi mot ignore_region; vat cao >=20px van ve tung box.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.1.6: nguong ignore_region ap dung ca cho khoi gan camera, khong chi vat o xa.

van_de: Bay 'loose' lot: box xe dap phu ca ro hang, sai lech kich thuoc so voi than xe (IoU < 0.9).
quyet_dinh: Truoc khi Accepted, kiem 4 canh box co nam tren than vat khong; box phinh ra phai keo lai.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.1.5: box om sat vat; sai lech kich thuoc >10% dien tich phai sua truoc khi Accepted.
